chart.name: Node queues messages ready - 1h change
chart.programText:
A = data('gauge.queue.messages_ready', filter=filter('plugin', 'rabbitmq')).sum().publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('gauge.queue.messages_ready', filter=filter('plugin', 'rabbitmq')).sum().timeshift('1h').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A-B).sum().publish(label='C')
